description: Champion: Hybrid Search (BM25 + Dense RRF) + Calibrated Confidence Gate + Semantic Chunking
hypothesis: Hybrid BM25 + Dense RRF achieves 100% HitRate@3 across all clean and adversarial queries with sub-60ms retrieval latency. Calibrated confidence gate completely halts out-of-domain hallucinations (0% hallucination rate on unanswerables) and reduces unanswerable query latency from 26 seconds to under 70 milliseconds.
